question: What does the most recent news article on proteinatlas.org report: which journal was the study published in, who led the team, and what did they identify?

turns.text:
Based on the news section of proteinatlas.org (https://www.proteinatlas.org/news):

1. **Most Recent Article Overall:**
   The chronologically most recent news article is *"Multiplex tissue image of the month - PDX1 in pancreas"* (dated September 10, 2026; https://www.proteinatlas.org/news/2026-09-10/multiplex-tissue-image-of-the-month-pdx1-in-pancreas). This article showcases multiplex immunohistochemistry (mIHC/IF) imaging of the transcription factor PDX1 in pancreatic beta cell nuclei and does not report on a journal study or a team leader.

2. **Most Recent News Article Reporting on a Study:**
   The news article reporting on a published research study matching the question's details is *"Reducing uncertainty in drug development: a Q&A with Thomas Helleday"* (dated September 2, 2026; https://www.proteinatlas.org/news/2026-09-02/reducing-uncertainty-in-drug-development-a-q-a-with-thomas-helleday):
   * **Journal:** The study was published in ***Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy*** (https://www.proteinatlas.org/news/2026-09-02/reducing-uncertainty-in-drug-development-a-q-a-with-thomas-helleday).
   * **Team leaders:** The team was led by **Thomas Helleday** and **Theodora Manolakou** (https://www.proteinatlas.org/news/2026-09-02/reducing-uncertainty-in-drug-development-a-q-a-with-thomas-helleday).
   * **What they identified:** They identified a **novel, targetable transcriptional-metabolic axis that sustains inflammatory T-cell responses** (specifically driven by MTHFD2-dependent one-carbon metabolism in rheumatoid arthritis) (https://www.proteinatlas.org/news/2026-09-02/reducing-uncertainty-in-drug-development-a-q-a-with-thomas-helleday).
